sql_templates.template:
WITH latest_trades AS (SELECT MAX(trade_date) AS latest_date FROM signals.fii_dii_flows), 
latest_data AS (SELECT * FROM signals.fii_dii_flows WHERE trade_date IN (SELECT latest_date FROM latest_trades)),
regime_data AS (SELECT * FROM signals.regime_history WHERE trade_date IN (SELECT latest_date FROM latest_trades)),
breadth_data AS (SELECT * FROM breadth.market_daily WHERE trade_date IN (SELECT latest_date FROM latest_trades)),
index_data AS (SELECT * FROM market.index_eod WHERE trade_date IN (SELECT latest_date FROM latest_trades)) 
SELECT ld.trade_date,
ld.fii_net_today, ld.dii_net_today, ld.flow_signal,
rd.regime, rd.confidence,
mb.ad_signal, mb.trin_signal,
mi.close AS index_close, mi.change_pct
FROM latest_data ld
JOIN regime_data rd ON ld.trade_date = rd.trade_date
JOIN breadth_data mb ON ld.trade_date = mb.trade_date
JOIN index_data mi ON ld.trade_date = mi.trade_date
WHERE mi.index_symbol = 'NIFTY 50'
ORDER BY ld.trade_date DESC LIMIT 20;
